question.problem:
Find the truth set of $P(x)∨Q(x)$ given the following predicates defined over the set of all positive integers:

- $P(x):$ $x$ divides $9$

- $Q(x):$ $x$ is less than $1$
question.worked_solution:
The truth set of $P(x)∨Q(x)$ represents the *union* of the truth sets of $P(x)$ and $Q(x):$

$$
{T}_{P∨Q}={T}_{P}\cup {T}_{Q}
$$

We start by finding the truth sets of $P(x)$ and $Q(x):$

- The truth set of $P(x)$ is

$$
{T}_{P}=\{1,3,9\}.
$$

- The truth set of $Q(x)$ is 

$$
{T}_{Q}=∅,
$$

 
the empty set, since there are no positive integers $x$ less than $1.$

Therefore, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{T}_{P∨Q} & ={T}_{P}\cup {T}_{Q} \\  & =\{1,3,9\}\cup ∅ \\  & =\{1,3,9\}.\end{aligned}
$$
